title: An error budget says what each contribution rests on, and the slab's is the one the tool derives
note: Part VI, item 20. Each mutation removes one rule of scientific/uncertainty.py or of the slab demonstration (tools/slab_uq.py): the refusal of a number for what nothing establishes, the measurement replacing its estimate, the comparison of the two propagations, the estimate held to its reference, the Monte Carlo's spread, the linear variance's units, the measurement's independence from the estimate. tests/test_slab_uq.py holds each, beside a negative control.

mutations.name: SU1_a_number_for_what_nothing_establishes
mutations.rationale: a contribution nothing establishes carries a number, which a reader takes for one

mutations.name: SU2_an_estimate_is_kept_beside_its_measurement
mutations.find: replaced = {c.supersedes for c in self.contributions if c.supersedes}
mutations.rationale: the discretization is counted twice, as estimated and as measured

mutations.name: SU3_the_propagations_always_agree
mutations.rationale: a response far from linear is reported as linear

mutations.name: SU4_the_estimate_always_covers
mutations.rationale: an estimate a reference contradicts is reported as covering it

mutations.name: SU5_the_monte_carlo_ignores_the_spread
mutations.rationale: the Monte Carlo samples one point, and its interval is the point

mutations.name: SU6_linear_propagation_drops_the_sigma
mutations.rationale: the linear variance is a sum of squared coefficients, in the wrong units

mutations.name: SU7_the_measurement_is_the_estimate_again
mutations.rationale: the discretization is 'measured' by repeating the model's own estimate

mutations.name: SU8_a_measurement_replaces_anything
mutations.find:
if c.supersedes is not None and not any(
                x.name == c.supersedes and x.basis == ESTIMATED
mutations.replace:
if False and not any(
                x.name == c.supersedes and x.basis == ESTIMATED
mutations.rationale: a measurement replaces an assumed or another measured contribution in the total
